visual_overrides.core_identity: A flowing mass of ordinary dungeon rats whose individual bodies remain readable while the group moves like a living tide.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Many low rat bodies overlapping in one readable stream, with pointed snouts and tails creating direction without forming a black pile.

scene_overrides.size_impression: A mass of tiny rats acting as one swarm; individual rats remain normal-sized and no giant leader dominates.
scene_overrides.natural_posture: Each rat stays low and quadrupedal while the swarm flows over floor, rubble, grates, or low obstacles.
behavior_style: pouring from a grate or opening in one clear direction
swarming around one simple food or route focal point
